resources.string: While casting, lets a TV, tablet or phone you\'ve approved operate this device: tap, swipe, scroll, D-pad, Back / Home / Recents, pinch to zoom, and, if you allow it, type into the current text field (except password fields). For safety, it only reads the name of the current app and screen (not any text on it), for example to pause control in the installer or accessibility settings. It doesn\'t read screen content or collect any data. It only works for the current cast after you confirm each time, and you can take back control at any time.

It only recognizes which app and screen are open (not any text on it), to pause control automatically on some screens (such as installing apps or granting permissions). No data is collected.
